native_review.lock_order: New timer invalidation runs under render RLock then state RLock, matching expiry, clear, reset and set_mode. Timer.cancel does not join. Cursor preacceptance releases state lock before acquiring render lock, and rechecks current session/cursor before invalidation.
native_review.stale_and_session_behavior: Ignored older/retired updates return before timer invalidation. New accepted session/render increments the token and empties cached arrows/bounds, so a delayed old expiry cannot redraw them. Current expiry remains valid for same-mode requests and ignored stale clears.
native_review.privacy_and_close: Mode changes invalidate old timer before native capture-policy transition. Failed policy readback stays hidden. Queued callbacks after close fail the token check. Native HWND/capture acceptance remains external.

validated_contracts: Final output/archive symbolic links and junctions rejected before path resolution
